nodes.label: Next.js Frontend

nodes.rationale: Media storage for cover images; secrets are restricted to the Go backend.

nodes.label: OpenAPI Specification
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for API request/response shapes and routing.

nodes.label: Supabase (Postgres + Auth)
nodes.rationale: Managed database and authentication provider; Go owns the schema via migrations.

nodes.label: Supabase Migrations
nodes.rationale: Authoritative schema definitions for profiles, divisions, posts, workflow_events, and media_assets.

nodes.label: Editorial Workflow State Machine
nodes.rationale: Maps to organizational SOP with statuses: draft, in_review, changes_requested, approved, published.

nodes.label: B-ILMOE System Architecture
nodes.rationale: Defines the high-level stack, component responsibilities, and editorial workflow for the B-ILMOE project.

links.rationale: Handlers are generated from the OpenAPI spec.
Signs upload requests; holds API secrets.
TS client is generated from the OpenAPI spec.
Uploads media directly using signatures issued by the Go API.
Verifies JWTs and manages Postgres access.
Go backend owns the schema via these migrations.
